subject: expression: keep the same order of scalarFunction's args when to prepagate constant (#64927)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (0dcf7ef6963a496f40b3102742bca863b3382622). Only behavior change in scope is `pkg/expression/util.go` (`ColumnSubstituteImpl`) adding a special-case for `ast.EQ` to ensure the post-substitution args keep `col = const` order when the left arg becomes a `*Constant` (`pkg/expression/util.go:684`).
